effects.actual_behavior: Server LivingEntity receives NECROSIS5/0 and Glowing5/0 every tick. voidlashtime<=0 sets inclusive random10..60 then requests anonymous FLY_INTO_WALL2, ignoring result, and overwrites velocity. For maxHP>=15: X=randomInt(-2,2)/(maxHP/20), Y/Z=randomInt(-2,2)/(maxHP/25), with native float division widened to double; otherwise independent raw randomInt(-2,2) components. Positive clock decrements1. Tornado NBT/command branches are particle-only.

effects.actual_behavior: Reads current WEBBED amplifier each branch, default0. A=0 requests Mining Fatigue3/1 and Slowness3/1 only if raw spidertype=false; A1,2,3 request both3/(A+1); A>=4 requests both3/5. Negative A has no matching effect branch. All child effects are ambient=true,visible=false on server LivingEntity; results ignored. Independently FlyFesterer always gets absolute velocity(0,-.2,0). Native wrapper level gates are retained.
